summary: Neatness at the f chosen places above q_i, which have norm q_i ≥ b^10.

steps.claim: By neatness (classAut_eq_bot for the f distinct chosen places w above q_i and the level of elements reducing to 1 modulo them), Γ ∩ gKg⁻¹ is trivial, so γ = 1 (the embedding is injective), provided (2|n|)^{[E:ℚ]} < ∏_w q_w = q_i^f; with [E : ℚ] = 2f and #chosenPlaces(i) = f this reduces to (2|n|)² < q_i.
steps.lean:
apply (map_eq_one_iff _ Fact.out).1 ((classAut_eq_bot _ _ le_rfl g).le ⟨⟨_, rfl⟩, _, funext h,
    rfl⟩) <;> simp [S.chosenPlaces_q i, S.card_chosenPlaces, finrank_eq_two_mul_card_infinitePlace,
    pow_mul]; rify; gcongr
grw [hn, ← le_levelPrime, ← k_le_b, ← S.ϱ_le_k.dest.choose_spec]; norm_cast; lia
